英文第40題｜堰塞湖如何形成

英文 / 綜合 / 綜合 · 首次出題日期：2026-09-08

分享原卷｜第 40 題

完整原題

作答所需文章／材料

The Quiet Lake The lake stays still under the sky, Its water level, like glass close by. The sunlight shines on the waves, And trees move slowly in the wind. It looks so safe, it looks so nice, A clear, shy mirror resting there. Birds fly over, the water shines, Showing mountains, clouds and skies. High in the mountains, the rocks push hard, A wall of earth, very strong. A river once ran free and fast, Now held back, it cannot pass. Heavy rain falls from the sky, Clouds get dark, the wind moves slow. The lake is calm, but still it rises. Its strong power waits, quiet and new. People walk along the road, They see the lake, they do not know. They do not see the wall may fall, The earth may shake, the lake may break. A landslide-dammed lake appears so small, But it can hurt both one and all. Its face is still, a calm place, Yet strong power waits hidden too. So when you go to this quiet lake, Remember still is not all safe. Think about the lake, its strong power, Its calm is a mask; the lake hides its power. 字詞：mirror 鏡子；calm 平靜的；hidden 隱藏的；poem 詩。
Which is the best way to explain a landslide-dammed lake? (A) People build a tall wall to stop a river. Water stays behind the wall. (B) Sometimes the land moves. Water collects in the low area and turns into a lake. (C) Rocks or mud fall from a hill or mountain and block a river. Water collects behind it. (D) A lake has no river going out. Water stays in the lake and can become heavy over time.
先想一想，再查看答案、解說與原圖
原卷作答：B
正確答案：C。山坡或山上的土石崩落、堵住河道，上游水體受阻累積，符合堰塞湖的形成。

逐項解析

選項與原句判讀句意與判斷理由
(A)
People build a tall wall to stop a river. Water stays behind the wall.		不選

這是人為築壩攔水的描述；原詩說山中的土石阻擋河流。

(B)
Sometimes the land moves. Water collects in the low area and turns into a lake.		不選

只說地動後低地積水，沒有說明崩落土石堵住河道這個關鍵。

(C)
Rocks or mud fall from a hill or mountain and block a river. Water collects behind it.		應選

山坡或山上的土石崩落、堵住河道，上游水體受阻累積，符合堰塞湖的形成。

(D)
A lake has no river going out. Water stays in the lake and can become heavy over time.		不選

缺少崩塌物阻塞河道的成因，不能用沒有出流河道或水變重來定義堰塞湖。

詳細說明與解題步驟

一、把複合字拆開
landslide 是山崩；dammed 是被攔阻；lake 是湖。合起來指山崩物質堵住河道所形成的湖。

二、回原詩找形成過程
High in the mountains, the rocks push hard；A wall of earth；A river once ran free and fast, now held back, it cannot pass。這些句子描述土石成為天然阻隔，讓原本流動的河水被擋住。

三、保留因果順序
土石崩落→堵塞河道→水在阻塞處上游累積成湖，符合 C。B 只說低地積水，遺漏河道被堵塞；原卷選 B，應補上這個必要條件。

本題以英文閱讀為主，跨自然的形成過程已在文章提供，不必另猜圖外條件。
原詩寫的是「A clear, shy mirror」，以害羞的鏡子擬人描寫湖面；不是先前整理的shiny。按原圖保留用字，不把不熟悉的詩句改成較常見的形容詞。
